title: 彭博：特朗普账户免费千元，真能变百万？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: On Saturday, July 4th, our administration deposited one-time seed contributions, $1,000 each into the Trump accounts of over 500,000 American children. It's a lot.
segments.zh: 7月4日周六，政府向50多万美国儿童的Trump账户存入1000美元初始资金。

segments.en: Trump accounts make a bold claim. Give your kid a head start by opening an investing account at Burr and let decades of compound growth potentially turn small contributions into millions of dollars.
segments.zh: Trump账户声称：在Burr开户，利用复利增长，小额投入也能变成百万美元。

segments.en: But did they live up to the hype, especially with so many other savings options out there?
segments.zh: 但与其他储蓄选项相比，它真的名副其实吗？

segments.en: If your child qualifies for the seed contribution, financial advisors say it's worth claiming.
segments.zh: 财务顾问表示，如果孩子符合条件，值得领取这笔初始资金。

segments.en: Kids born between 2025 through 2028 receive a $1,000 federal deposit.
segments.zh: 2025至2028年出生的孩子将获得1000美元联邦存款。

segments.en: And that free money could turn into thousands more by the time they turn 18.
segments.zh: 这笔免费资金到孩子18岁时可能增值数千美元。

segments.en: Financial planners say the best strategy isn't choosing one account over another.
segments.zh: 理财规划师表示，最佳策略不是二选一。

segments.en: Think of a Trump account as a retirement account for your child. The money is locked up until adulthood, so it's less flexible than a traditional brokerage account.
segments.zh: Trump账户类似孩子的退休账户，资金锁定至成年，灵活性低于传统经纪账户。

segments.en: And not as tax-efficient as a 529 plan if your goal is paying for college.
segments.zh: 若目标是支付大学费用，其税收效率不如529计划。

segments.en: The real opportunity comes when your child is an adult. The Trump account can be converted into a Roth IRA, allowing future investment growth to become tax-free.
segments.zh: 真正机会在孩子成年后：Trump账户可转为Roth IRA，未来**收益免税。

segments.en: Bottom line, take the free money if you're eligible. But make sure a Trump account fits into your family's broader savings strategy.
segments.zh: 总之，符合条件就领取免费资金。但确保特朗普账户符合家庭整体储蓄策略。
